rtxremix.settings.preview.tip: Hide the panel to inspect the applied effects. Apply pending changes first.
rtxremix.settings.resetPending.tip: Stage defaults for this folder. At the root, reset all visual settings. Apply to commit; Cancel to discard.
rtxremix.settings.editHint: Drag to adjust. Right-click or Ctrl-click for exact input. Shift-click to restore the default. Apply commits all folders together.
rtxremix.setting.fog.automatic.tip: Patchy ground mist appears near dawn and during wet weather in humid biomes.
rtxremix.setting.fog.automaticStrength.t: Scales automatic condensation density. Map biome and zone profiles can override its appearance.
rtxremix.effect.mist.baseHeight.tip: World height below which ground mist reaches full density.
rtxremix.effect.mist.heightFalloff.tip: Height in blocks for ground-mist density to fall by a factor of e above its base.
rtxremix.effect.mist.regionSize.tip: Horizontal size of the world-space mist patches, in blocks.
rtxremix.effect.fog.baseHeight.tip: World height below which the authored fog reaches full density. Ground mist has its own height controls.
rtxremix.effect.fog.heightFalloff.tip: Height in blocks for density to fall by a factor of e above its base. Zero selects uniform fog.
rtxremix.effect.water.ior.tip: Index of refraction. Typical clear water is about 1.33.
rtxremix.effect.water.absorptionDistance: Distance in blocks used to measure the water transmittance color.
rtxremix.effect.water.red.tip: Red-channel light transmission at the water optical distance.
rtxremix.effect.water.green.tip: Green-channel light transmission at the water optical distance.
rtxremix.effect.water.blue.tip: Blue-channel light transmission at the water optical distance.
rtxremix.effect.water.animationFps.tip: Water normal-animation frames per second. Zero holds the first frame.
rtxremix.effect.fog.transmittance.red.ti: Light transmission color at the fog optical distance, in sRGB.
Light transmission color at the fog optical distance, in sRGB.
rtxremix.effect.fog.transmittance.blue.t: Light transmission color at the fog optical distance, in sRGB.
rtxremix.effect.fog.scatteringAlbedo.red: Fraction of extinguished light scattered rather than absorbed; linear RGB.
rtxremix.effect.fog.scatteringAlbedo.gre: Fraction of extinguished light scattered rather than absorbed; linear RGB.
rtxremix.effect.fog.scatteringAlbedo.blu: Fraction of extinguished light scattered rather than absorbed; linear RGB.
rtxremix.effect.image.colorBalance.red.t: Color-channel gains when Global tone mapping and color grading are enabled.
rtxremix.effect.image.colorBalance.green: Color-channel gains when Global tone mapping and color grading are enabled.
Color-channel gains when Global tone mapping and color grading are enabled.
rtxremix.effect.clouds.windSpeed.tip: Multiplier on wind-driven cloud movement. Zero freezes advection.
rtxremix.effect.clouds.anisotropy.tip: Controls the directionality of light scattering by cloud droplets.
rtxremix.effect.clouds.multipleScatterin: Strength of the approximate diffuse light transport inside dense clouds.
rtxremix.effect.clouds.coverage.tip: Fraction of the cloud density field filled with clouds; rain adds coverage.
rtxremix.effect.clouds.shapeScale.tip: Horizontal size of cloud formations in blocks.
rtxremix.effect.clouds.density.tip: Extinction per block. Higher density increases opacity and self-shadowing.
rtxremix.effect.clouds.distance.tip: Cloud ray integration distance in blocks, independent of terrain render distance.
rtxremix.effect.clouds.samples.tip: Maximum samples through the three-dimensional cloud field. More samples cost GPU time.
rtxremix.effect.clouds.shadowSamples.tip: Samples used for sunlight and moonlight attenuation within clouds.
rtxremix.effect.fog.range.tip: Distance in blocks at which the configured fog transmittance is measured.
rtxremix.effect.fog.anisotropy.tip: Negative values scatter backward; zero scatters evenly; positive values favor forward shafts.
rtxremix.effect.fog.translucentShadows.t: Allows water and colored glass to attenuate light entering the fog.
rtxremix.effect.fog.noise.tip: Adds world-space variation to volumetric fog density.
rtxremix.effect.fog.noiseSpeed.tip: Speed of the density field when density variation is enabled.
rtxremix.effect.fog.noiseScale.tip: Density scale for the heterogeneous fog field.
rtxremix.effect.fog.noiseExponent.tip: Higher values separate clear gaps from dense fog banks.
rtxremix.effect.fog.noiseFrequency.tip: Spatial frequency of the fog density field, per block.
rtxremix.effect.shadows.direct.tip: Enables direct lighting from the sun, moon and local emitters.
rtxremix.effect.shadows.indirect.tip: Enables secondary light transport, including bounced illumination.
rtxremix.effect.shadows.coloredDirect.ti: Evaluates colored transparent occluders for direct lighting.
Evaluates colored transparent occluders along secondary-light paths.
rtxremix.effect.reflection.psrr.tip: Preserves specular paths through smooth reflecting surfaces.
rtxremix.effect.reflection.pstr.tip: Preserves refracted paths through water and glass.
rtxremix.effect.materials.normalStrength: Strength of normal maps on opaque PBR materials.
rtxremix.effect.water.normalStrength.tip: Strength of transparent-surface normal maps, including animated water. Also affects glass normal maps.
rtxremix.effect.sss.inRefraction.tip: Keeps thin-surface light transmission on refracted leaf and plant surfaces.
rtxremix.effect.sss.transmission.tip: Enables light transmission within materials carrying subsurface data.
rtxremix.effect.sss.singleScattering.tip: Adds the single-scattering component of subsurface transmission.
rtxremix.effect.sss.diffusionScale.tip: Scales diffusion-profile radii on materials using diffusion profiles.
rtxremix.effect.bloom.strength.tip: Intensity of halos around bright regions.
rtxremix.effect.bloom.threshold.tip: Suppresses bloom from dim regions below this luminance.
rtxremix.effect.image.tonemapper.tip: 0: Global. 1: Local. The matching controls below only affect their selected mode.
rtxremix.effect.image.localContrast.tip: Enhances local contrast when Local tone mapping is selected.
rtxremix.effect.image.localAces.tip: Applies the ACES finishing curve after Local tone mapping.
rtxremix.effect.image.globalExposure.tip: Exposure compensation for Global tone mapping.
rtxremix.effect.image.grading.tip: Enables the following color controls in Global tone-mapping mode.
rtxremix.effect.image.contrast.tip: Contrast in Global mode with color grading enabled.
rtxremix.effect.image.saturation.tip: Saturation in Global mode with color grading enabled.
rtxremix.effect.exposure.enabled.tip: Adapts exposure when moving between dark and bright environments.
rtxremix.effect.exposure.speed.tip: Higher values adapt more quickly to changes in scene brightness.
rtxremix.effect.exposure.center.tip: Gives the center of the image more influence on exposure.
rtxremix.effect.exposure.centerSize.tip: Size of the emphasized region when center metering is enabled.
rtxremix.effect.exposure.average.tip: 0: Mean. 1: Median; more stable around extreme brightness.
rtxremix.video.frameGeneration.tip: Generates intermediate frames without lowering rendering quality. Available multipliers depend on the GPU and driver. Paused screens use rendered frames only.
rtxremix.preparingRenderingTimedOut: RTX rendering did not become ready within two minutes. Check the renderer log before trying again.
container.rtx-remix-renderer.copper_beac: Sets the color saturation of this beacon's lens and beam from grayscale to twice the dye's saturation.
Sets this placed beacon's beam and glowing lens brightness. Off disables both.
Sets the beam half-angle. 90 degrees illuminates a full forward hemisphere.
When enabled, the beam and head animation run only while the beacon receives redstone power.
Sets the axis's neutral angle. Animated bounds are offsets around this position.
Sets signed continuous rotation speed in degrees per second.
Sets the minimum animated offset from the neutral position.
Sets the maximum animated offset from the neutral position.
Sets the duration of one complete smooth oscillation.
Sets the time between deterministic smooth patrol targets.
rtxremix.settings.title: RTX Remix Shader Settings
rtxremix.settings.reset.tip: Restore the settings on this page to their default values.
rtxremix.settings.reset.confirm.title: Reset %s Settings?
rtxremix.settings.reset.confirm.message: This resets every setting in %s. Continue?
rtxremix.settings.resetAll.tip: Restore all visual effects to their defaults. Performance settings remain in Sodium.
rtxremix.settings.resetAll.confirm.title: Reset All Visual Effects?
rtxremix.settings.resetAll.confirm.messa: This resets lighting, sky, weather, materials and post-processing. Continue?
rtxremix.setting.fog.enabled.tip: Light scattering and absorption in the atmosphere, including local lights and shafts.
rtxremix.settings.blockLights.title: Block Lights
rtxremix.setting.dist.autoFade.tip: Match the Remix terrain fade band to Minecraft's render distance without overriding stronger situational profiles.
rtxremix.setting.dist.light.tip: Chunks beyond which block lights are culled. Auto follows Minecraft's render distance.
rtxremix.setting.dist.entity.tip: Chunks beyond which entities are not submitted. Auto uses Minecraft's view distance.
rtxremix.setting.light.reach.tip: Blocks from the camera at which a torch stops casting light. Brighter lights reach further and dimmer ones less. Lower values shrink the light list the path tracer samples from.
rtxremix.setting.framerate.unfocused.tip: Framerate cap while the game window is not focused. Lower values leave the GPU to other applications. Unlimited leaves only Minecraft's Max Framerate in force.
rtxremix.setting.sky.ambient.tip: Toggle the ambient area light derived from the sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.haloFocus.tip: Controls how tightly atmospheric haze gathers around the sun and moon. Higher values create smaller, brighter halos; lower values spread a softer glow across more of the sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.minimumCelestialWea: Limits how much rain and thunder can hide the sun, moon, and stars. Time of day and horizon visibility are unchanged.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.procedural.tip: Choose Volumetric for three-dimensional participating clouds or Classic for Minecraft's blocky cloud style.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.vanillaEdgeSmoot: Softens the edges of Minecraft's classic blocky clouds. Set this to zero for sharp, square edges.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.size.tip: Changes the thickness of Classic clouds. Volumetric cloud thickness and shape scale have separate controls.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.height.tip: Moves clouds higher or lower in the sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.sunIntensity.tip: Controls the brightness of direct sunlight. 1.00 uses the intended balance.
rtxremix.setting.sky.moonIntensity.tip: Controls the brightness of moonlight. 1.00 uses the intended balance.
rtxremix.setting.sky.dayAmbient.tip: Controls the strength of soft light from the daytime sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.nightAmbient.tip: Controls the strength of soft light from the night sky.
Multiplies this block light's normal brightness. Off disables it; 1.00× keeps the intended brightness. Changes apply when you leave this screen and rebuild loaded terrain once.
rtxremix.setting.materials.terrainEmissi: Multiplies the light emitted by glowing block surfaces. Off disables their glow; 1.00× keeps the intended brightness. This does not change block lights such as torches.
rtxremix.setting.materials.smoothReliefM: Samples normal and height maps smoothly, which removes banding from surface bumps and depth, while block textures keep their pixelated look.
rtxremix.setting.post.exposure.tip: Makes the whole scene brighter or darker. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.shadows.tip: Controls how bright shaded areas appear. Raise it to reveal more detail in shadows. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.highlights.tip: Controls sunlight, emissive blocks, and other very bright areas. Raise it to darken intense highlights and preserve more detail. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.lowLightAdaptation: Helps you see in dark places. Lower values reveal more detail, but can make illuminated areas look pale or washed out. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.highLightAdaptatio: Helps your view adjust to very bright scenes so sunlight and emissive blocks remain comfortable and readable. Higher values tame harsh brightness, but can make daylight look dimmer. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.video.title: Path Tracing
rtxremix.video.enabled.tip: Render the world with RTX Remix path tracing. Apply once to rebuild terrain when switching.
rtxremix.video.preset.tip: Higher presets improve lighting at a higher GPU cost. Choose Custom to adjust DLSS and Ray Reconstruction.
rtxremix.video.dlss.tip: Disable upscaling with native-resolution DLAA. Quality, Balanced and Performance use DLSS Super Resolution. Ray Reconstruction is independent. Available with the Custom preset.
rtxremix.video.reconstruction.tip: Use DLSS Ray Reconstruction to reconstruct path-traced lighting and material detail. Available with the Custom preset.
rtxremix.video.blockLights.tip: Adjust light intensity for individual blocks.
rtxremix.video.advanced.volumeGrid.tip: Render pixels per lighting cell. Smaller spacing resolves finer light shafts, using more GPU time and video memory. Does not change surface textures.
rtxremix.video.advanced.volumeDepth.tip: Depth samples in the ray-traced lighting volume. More layers resolve finer shadow boundaries and use proportionally more GPU time and video memory.
rtxremix.video.advanced.volumeHistory.ti: Maximum accumulated lighting frames. Longer history reduces noise but responds more slowly to moving lights and shadows.
rtxremix.video.advanced.indirect.tip: Select the indirect-lighting algorithm. SHaRC is the default; NRC requires a supported NVIDIA GPU. Custom quality preset required.
rtxremix.video.advanced.bounces.tip: More bounces preserve more indirect-light transport at a higher GPU cost. Native supported range: 0–15.
rtxremix.video.advanced.rtxdi.tip: Reservoir sampling improves direct lighting with many lights. Disabling it uses the runtime’s simpler light sampler.
rtxremix.video.advanced.sparse.tip: Trace fewer pixels and reconstruct them with DLSS Ray Reconstruction. Requires DLSS and Ray Reconstruction; otherwise the runtime suspends sparse rendering.
rtxremix.video.advanced.cacheQuality.tip: Medium uses fewer update records. Ultra uses the fixed update grid. Higher quality costs more GPU time.
rtxremix.video.advanced.cacheCombine.tip: Combine update and query tracing to reduce dispatch overhead. Lighting queries read the previous frame’s resolved cache.
rtxremix.video.advanced.cachePrimary.tip: Use the radiance cache for leaves and other thin opaque surfaces. Disabling it increases tracing work and can change noise.
rtxremix.video.advanced.cacheFilter.tip: Filter cached lighting using compatible surface normals. Material textures are not blurred.
rtxremix.video.advanced.cacheSpatialJitt: Jitter thin-surface cache queries to reduce visible voxel boundaries.
rtxremix.video.advanced.cacheLodJitter.t: Stochastically blend adjacent cache levels to soften level transitions.
rtxremix.video.advanced.volumetrics.tip: Render the runtime’s volumetric lighting and fog. Requires additional GPU work.
rtxremix.video.advanced.bloom.tip: Add glowing halos around bright areas.
